# CDOT Stations - Frequently Asked Questions
**Version:** 0.1.0

## General Questions
**What is CDOT Stations?**
A dashboard for accessing and monitoring Colorado transportation station information.


**Who is this product for?**
This product is designed for users within the SaaS space.

## Billing & Access
**How is this product billed?**
Billing is managed via Stripe.

**How do I get access?**
Access is granted via the cdot_stations_access entitlement.

## Support
**What level of support do I receive?**
Your subscription includes Standard support.
